## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (97%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-1 surgical frozen section with single-class prediction [F1] and clear margins [F7], despite severity-3 blur.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 97%, InSitu 3%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | High invasive risk; test ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; OOD percentile 1.0 (12/12 regions) [F6] | Unflagged despite blur; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%, similarity 0.70–0.78) [F5] | One Benign neighbor at 0.68 similarity |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical embedding score (+1.01 contribution) pushing toward invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.80 contribution), failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.52 contribution), failed AI spot check (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical duct confinement (+0.42 contribution); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical benign stroma (+0.42 contribution); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable mitoses and normal-lobules concepts (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur on this simulated frozen section masks benign tubules, mimicking contrast case BACH_0284 (Benign, similarity 0.68).
- Unreliable mitoses and normal-lobules scores drive the read while stains remain blocked on simulated frozen sections.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 7, 11**: Highest risk (0.95–1.00); confirm stromal invasion and lateral/inferior margin clearance (strip 108 um).
2. **Regions 0, 10, 11**: Visually verify mitotic figures; the model's mitosis concept is unreliable (0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 1, 4, 9**: Check lower-risk areas (0.01–0.70) for preserved lobules, duct confinement, or benign tubules.
